article.story: PEORIA, Ill. -- — DeAndre Craig scored 21 points as Purdue Fort Wayne beat Bradley 78-73 on Wednesday. Craig added five assists for the Mastodons (3-2). E.J. Mosley scored 15 points while going 5 of 10 from the floor, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and 3 for 3 from the line, and added four steals. Anthony Isaac shot 6 of 10 from the field and 2 for 3 from the line to finish with 14 points. Trevon Payton led the way for the Braves (3-3) with 16 points. Bradley also got 16 points from Max Gaspa. Noah Williams also had 12 points. Purdue Fort Wayne went into halftime leading Bradley 37-36. Mosley scored 11 points in the half. Craig scored 16 points in the second half to help lead Purdue Fort Wayne to a five-point victory. Up next Both teams next play Saturday. Purdue Fort Wayne hosts Calumet and Bradley goes on the road to play Pacific. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
